title: Counter
summary: One PDA. initialize stores the authority. increment adds a u64 when the signer matches.

title: Ledger
summary: FixedArray of four u64 slots, a deposit, an if/else apply, and a for-range fill.

title: Vault
summary: Lamport PDA. deposit uses system_transfer. close returns the lamports to the authority.

title: Escrow
summary: One lamport deal. make funds the PDA, take pays the maker and closes to the taker, cancel closes to the maker.
